input: Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also set /turn/ply.num to the current ply and be co-signed by at least twelve of the sixteen Black agents' keys excluding the moving piece's own key, and any commit that modifies /moves/knight_b8.text or /moves/pawn_c7.text must be co-signed by at least fourteen of the sixteen Black agents' keys, so that pieces that have repeatedly gone off plan need near-unanimous team agreement.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/$k.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/knight_b8.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/pawn_c7.text) -threshold("14", /team/pieces)] false)
